outline:
懸吊系統型式、彈簧、避震器、轉向系統介紹、輪胎定位、懸吊機構和轉向機構之運動幾何、懸吊系統和轉向系統之力量分析。
Types of Suspension System, Springs, Dampers, Introduction to Steering System, Wheel Alignment, Kinematic Geometry of Suspension and Steering Mechanisms, Force Analysis of Suspension and Steering Systems.
